enforceable_by: OpenClaw tool policy (allow non-empty => everything else blocked; deny always wins). NOT prompt-only.

durable_model_change.rationale: text-only entry; cannot accept image pixels; attachments arrive as media://inbound/* refs

allow_notes: ingest_attachment: the only ingestion channel; args bound by Channel adapter, model cannot pass arbitrary paths
message: reply to original group only; target bound by Channel context (session.sendPolicy + visibleReplies)
sessions_spawn: restricted by subagents.allowAgents whitelist of 3 analyzers; requireAgentId=true
memory_search/memory_get: P0 task management; optional, kept for MVP
deny_notes: group:runtime (exec/process/code_execution/bash): no host commands on the router
group:fs (read/write/edit/apply_patch): no arbitrary file IO; ingest_attachment does controlled fs internally
group:media (image/image_generate/music_generate/video_generate/tts): no pre-reply media understanding, no generation
group:web (web_search/x_search/web_fetch): no outbound web from group text
group:plugins (all plugin/MCP tools): the ingest MCP server is allowlisted by exact name ingest__ingest_attachment, not by group:plugins
sessions_yield / subagents: router does not yield; subagents tool blocked, only sessions_spawn allowed
exec_mode_change: remove agents.list[video-factory].tools.exec.mode=full (avoid audit ambiguity with deny group:runtime)
elevated_note: tools.elevated.enabled=true + allowFrom.feishu=[*] is GLOBAL and NOT changed this round. Elevated does NOT override tool deny (docs: 'Elevated is not skill-scoped and does not override tool allow/deny'). With deny group:runtime, elevated cannot grant exec to the router.
mcp_tool_naming: The ingest_attachment MCP server is registered as mcp.servers.ingest; its tool is exposed as ingest__ingest_attachment under bundle-mcp. The router allow list must include the exact name ingest__ingest_attachment (OpenClaw may also accept the bare name; both are added to be safe).
not_prompt_only: All constraints are enforced by agents.list[video-factory].tools.allow/deny + subagents.allowAgents, not by AGENTS.md or system prompt. AGENTS.md documents the flow rules; tool policy is the hard stop.
no_global_defaults_change: agents.defaults.model, agents.defaults.imageModel (unset), tools.exec, tools.elevated, tools.web, tools.sessions.visibility, skills.entries are NOT changed. Only agents.list[video-factory] is tightened. Other 13 agents unaffected.
